steps.content: You see a group of people gathering on the roadside staring down at their devices, as if counting down to some extraordinary event.

steps.speaker: Fervent Fan
steps.content: Nino Sama! Nino Sama! We adore you!

steps.speaker: Excited Fan
steps.content: Boohoo, I can't survive another second without Nino Sama's live stream!

steps.speaker: Enthusiastic Fan
steps.content: I can't anymore! I'm going feral! I'm going feral right here, right now!!!

steps.speaker: Fervent Fan
steps.content: Huh, you don't know Nino Sama? Have you been living under a rock? She's the hottest streamer right now!

steps.speaker: Enthusiastic Fan
steps.content: I'm a Lv.9 fan of her live stream channel. I've sent her so many gifts. Nino Sama often reads my comments!
It seems that Nino is safe and sound, and you're finally relieved. But somehow you feel that you will meet that girl again one day.
